generation_policy: Contract-gated: generated only for previously uncovered L2 features with a nonblank L2 what contract; contract contents are treated as provisionally correct per user instruction.

feature.description: Model reusable processes, SOPs, approval chains, workflow stages, transitions, and their required inputs, outputs, policies, and capabilities.

contract.purpose_user_function: Persist reusable workflow stages, dependencies, transitions, gates, roles, inputs/outputs, policies, and capabilities.
contract.valid_inputs: Workflow contract/template JSON, stages, dependencies, triggers, inputs, outputs, roles, capsules, gates, and constraints.
contract.expected_outputs: Validated workflow contract and instantiated TaskGraph/Plan IR.
contract.state_side_effects: Reads workflow/config files and produces instantiated graph artifacts; authoring changes workflow files.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Schema error, cycle, missing stage/dependency, unresolvable role/capsule, illegal scope, or policy conflict rejects compilation.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: Workflow contracts and task graphs are shipped; a general cross-domain SOP knowledge graph/query service is partial.
contract.success_evidence: Workflow validates, instantiates deterministically, and produces resolvable nodes/dependencies/gates; negative workflow-contract tests reject invalid graphs.
contract.granularity_atomic_contracts: load; trigger match; instantiate; dependency cycle; missing role/capsule; gate/policy; version.
contract.readme_product_docs: docs/AI_NATIVE_OS_ARCHITECTURE.md §Seamless long-term memory and semantic indexing; docs/MEMORY_SYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE.md; docs/solar-architecture-code-map.md §8
contract.cli_api_skill_interfaces: core/smi/query.ts: SMIQuery and quickSearch(); core/ontology/manager.ts: OntologyManager; harness/lib/task_graph_io.py; harness/lib/evidence_ledger.py: EvidenceLedger
contract.implementation_entrypoints: harness/lib/workflow_contract.py: load_contract(), validate_contract_schema(), instantiate(), compile_checks(); harness/config/workflows/*.workflow.json
contract.platform_provider_limitations: File/SQLite-backed operations are local; optional semantic/vector, wiki, Mirage/QMD, and external source services require their configured processes, indexes, mounts, or credentials.

implementation.entrypoints: harness/lib/workflow_contract.py: load_contract(), validate_contract_schema(), instantiate(), compile_checks(); harness/config/workflows/*.workflow.json
implementation.interfaces: core/smi/query.ts: SMIQuery and quickSearch(); core/ontology/manager.ts: OntologyManager; harness/lib/task_graph_io.py; harness/lib/evidence_ledger.py: EvidenceLedger
